jobs.title: ANY SUITABLE POSITION (MANPOWER POOLING)
jobs.jobSite: Any country – matched to the best-fit position
jobs.qualifications:
GENERAL TALENT POOL — choose this if none of the listed positions match your profile. Your application is screened for overseas employability and matched to the position(s) that best fit your experience.

Minimum requirements:
• Filipino citizen, at least 21 years old (18 for some skilled trades)
• Valid passport, or willing to secure one before deployment
• At least 1 year of documented work experience in any skilled, technical, hospitality, healthcare, construction, manufacturing, logistics, or service role
• Basic English (spoken and written)
• Willing to undergo medical examination, PDOS/PEOS and other DMW pre-deployment requirements
• No unresolved employment or travel restrictions

Advantages:
• TESDA NC II or higher, or an equivalent trade/professional certification
• Previous overseas work experience
• Professional driver's license, safety or HACCP/food-handling training
• Experience in high-demand fields: welding, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, heavy equipment, CNC/machining, hospitality (F&B, housekeeping, cook), caregiving/nursing, warehouse/logistics, factory production

Screening note: QUALIFIED = minimum requirements met and experience relevant to a position Link Asia normally recruits for; TALENT POOL = limited experience but trainable profile; NOT QUALIFIED only when the minimum requirements are clearly not met. The screening result names the best-fit position(s).

jobs.title: BLOCK WORK TRADESMAN
jobs.qualifications:
Experience required: Five years' masonry or bricklaying experience.

Requirements / duties:
• Lays building materials, including concrete, and constructs or repairs surfaces or structures. Working conditions may include restricted movement, dirty environment, extreme temperatures, and lifting or carrying heavy objects.
• Interpret technical drawings and follow their instructions, read blueprints or drawings to calculate the materials needed
• Lay out patterns, forms, or foundations according to plans
• Prepares surfaces before beginning work.
• Break or cut materials to the required size
• Mix mortar or grout and spread it onto a slab or foundation
• Clean excess mortar with trowels and other hand tools
• Use equipment and tools to safely perform basic construction tasks
• Construct masonry walls
• Align structures, using levels and plumbs, lays out work using chalk lines, plumb bobs, tapes, squares, and levels
• Fill expansion joints with caulking materials
• Lift and carry concrete blocks, and stones from place to place
• Clean and polish surfaces with hand tools or power tools
• Correct any safety hazards and report them to the foreman
• Train apprentices as needed to ensure projects are completed in a timely manner
• Experience working with other professionals on a construction site.
• Knowledge of related tools, masonry techniques, equipment and materials.
• Skill in the construction, alteration, repair, and maintenance of masonry structures and surfaces.
• Good knowledge in installing masonry-related accessories
• Good knowledge in performing Lintels and Spacer Columns

jobs.title: PCBA TECHNICIAN
jobs.jobSite: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia – electronics (PCBA) manufacturing plant
jobs.salaryBenefits:
• Competitive salary
• Free accommodation
• Transportation provided
• Medical insurance
jobs.qualifications:
Job summary: responsible for supporting Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) manufacturing operations, including SMT and THT production, machine operation, PCB inspection, rework, material handling and production support. Requires strong hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing and adherence to quality and ESD standards.

Qualifications:
• Minimum 4 years of practical hands-on experience in a PCBA manufacturing environment
• Experience with SMT/THT processes, AOI, X-Ray inspection, PCB rework and hand soldering
• Familiarity with electronic components, BOMs and ESD handling procedures
• Diploma in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field is preferred
• IPC certification (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001 or equivalent) is an advantage

Key responsibilities:
• Operate and support SMT and THT production lines
• Operate AOI and X-Ray inspection equipment
• Perform PCB inspection, troubleshooting, rework and hand soldering
• Handle electronic components and raw materials in accordance with ESD procedures
• Prepare materials, package finished products and support production activities
• Maintain accurate production records and follow company quality and safety procedures

Skills: strong attention to detail and manual dexterity; good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills; able to work independently and as part of a production team; commitment to quality, safety and continuous improvement.
